people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
translations.bsb: So men of all nations came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
translations.kjv: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
translations.asv: And there came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
